description: This file defines the IRuntimeClient interface and the OnDeserializedCallbacks class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The interface specifies the API surface exposed to both silo and client components, including methods for managing timeouts, sending and receiving messages, and managing object references. The class provides a helper for invoking deserialization callbacks.

classes.name: IRuntimeClient
classes.description: Defines a subset of the Orleans runtime API exposed to clients and silos, including methods for time management, message handling, object references, and runtime info.

classes.name: OnDeserializedCallbacks
classes.description: A helper class that invokes the OnDeserialized method on objects implementing IOnDeserialized immediately after deserialization.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Invokes the OnDeserialized method on the provided IOnDeserialized object, passing the current context.
